title: Claims Operations Rule for Inpatient Days Posted From TRICARE Select Facility Lines, Referrals and Authorizations
content:
This claims operations rule fixes how many inpatient days a TRICARE Select facility claim line posts as used against a Skilled Nursing Facility Authorization or an Inpatient Mental Health Authorization under **Referrals and Authorizations**.

## Posting rule

1. **The line.** The line counted is the facility claim line billed under the authorization that was most recently posted for it. Its service date is its first covered day, and its inpatient days are the covered inpatient days it carries.
2. **Covered days.** The days a facility claim line posts as used are the covered inpatient days that line carries, counted from its service date as its first covered day; the discharge day is never a covered day, as the type's unit definition requires. The line's last covered day is therefore its service date plus its inpatient days, less one day.
3. **Span end.** A covered day that falls after the last day of the authorization's validity span is not posted.
4. **Units left.** The days posted are never more than the units left on the authorization, that is, the units granted plus the units added by extensions less the units already posted, all read from its unit history; and never fewer than zero.
5. **Service date of the use.** The use is entered with the first day of the line that the posting counts as its service date, and keeps the line's claim number and line number.

## Worked example (hypothetical inputs)

- Facility line: service date 3 March, 10 covered inpatient days, so the covered days run from 3 March to 12 March.
- Authorization: last span day 9 March; 14 days granted, no extension, 5 days already posted, so 9 days are left.
- Covered days after 9 March (10, 11 and 12 March) are not posted: 10 days less 3 days gives 7 days.
- 7 days is not more than the 9 days left, so 7 days are posted, with service date 3 March.

## Second example (hypothetical inputs)

The same line on an authorization with only 4 days left posts 4 days: the 7 days within the span are more than the units left, and the days posted never exceed the units left.

## Quick reference

| Input | Read from |
|---|---|
| Line's first covered day and covered days | the facility claim line's service date and inpatient days |
| Last span day | the authorization's validity span |
| Units granted, added and already posted | the authorization's unit history |
